backup.production_rule: SINGLE SHOT: the migration is not re-runnable (a second run stops on its own md5 guard, 55000, nothing changed); to undo apply the rollback. Decision Lloyd 2026-10-15: a cleaner (Honey, submit_cleaning) may set the remaining amount of an item. Two function bodies change and one internal function is added; no table, column, grant or policy changes. reconcile_inventory_baseline_v1 and inventory_undo_v1 accept manage_inventory (owner, admin) OR submit_cleaning on the item's property; refusals stay 42501. record_inventory_movement only accepts owner/admin (inventory_human_authorized), so for anyone else both functions write the movement through the new s_inventory_staff_movement_v1 (reconcile and adjustment only, executable by no client role); the owner/admin path is unchanged. A cleaner can undo only their OWN count (not_yours otherwise), and never a purchase. Round 2: the own-count undo also covers a usage movement (kind usage, written by record_inventory_usage on movement-controlled items), within the same 15 minutes and stock_moved guard; it reverses with an adjustment through the same writers and leaves the inventory_usage row as it is. Rehearsal-only failures: the s84 suite fails 6 grant assertions (tests 2, 3, 7, 64, 110, 111) on the --no-acl restore; all six were read on LIVE read-only on 2026-10-15 and live holds every one (column grants on all but unit_cost, unit_cost closed, anon executes none of the five RPCs nor undo/history, authenticated executes them, s_inventory_low_task_v1 has no grant and is definer with an empty search_path), so the failure is the restore, not the release. The migration stops (55000) unless the live bodies are exactly the ones cut from (md5 of prosrc, CR stripped: reconcile 7cba4397244b2e666b57cd43fb3b31a9, undo f2a56a60c4f077871966e797ebd35a83, read from production 2026-10-15). Apply AFTER s84_inventory_20261017. restore_point is a placeholder: the release block fills it (fill-restore-point.mjs). Rehearsal: see docs/s85/rehearsal-count.log.
backup.notes: Deploy order: SQL first, then the staff app (the stock Count button may be shown to the cleaner role once this is live; before it, a cleaner gets 42501). No new secret.

rollback.safe_until: always. The rollback puts reconcile_inventory_baseline_v1 and inventory_undo_v1 back to the exact live bodies this release was cut from (owner and admin only) and drops s_inventory_staff_movement_v1. Movements a cleaner wrote stay (the ledger is append-only); the items they counted stay movement-controlled.
